purpose: AML status record. It explains what was checked, what the source trail proves, and what authority the system still does not have without exposing code locations or local record locations.
privacy_boundary: Public summaries only. No local machine paths, private module locations, raw commands, secrets, private infrastructure, account-level details, employer data, or client data.
reading_rule: Every visible claim should resolve to a contract doc, test evidence record, record contract, or explicit boundary.
visible_claims: An AML status row is useful only when source coverage, counts, rule coverage, and freshness are visible together.
Planning outputs keep outside action set to false on every public-facing branch.
Private records keep checksums and latest snapshots locally; the public page shows only the summary record and clear limit.
The public page is a status record, not an operational compliance product.

provenance.contract_module: Private contract module, not published on the public page
provenance.refresher_module: Private refresher module, not published on the public page
provenance.planning_endpoint: Private planning endpoint, not published on the public page
provenance.local_artifact_pattern: Private operations record with timestamped snapshot, latest alias, and checksum sidecar

checks.label: Contract status checks
checks.command: Private AML contract test suite completed locally
checks.recorded_result: The public record stores the verification summary, not raw commands or private locations.

checks.label: Compile and wiring checks
checks.command: Private module compile and wiring checks completed locally
checks.recorded_result: The public record stores the check category and result only.

boundary.boundary_label: No wallet, trade, filing, or deploy authority. No KYC approval authority.

next_steps: Keep public AML records summary-first and raw-command-free.
Keep detailed records out of the reader-facing summary unless a redacted version is prepared.
Review new status records for private locations, instruction text, account data, and operational internals before publishing.
